phase.title: Web Bootstrap, Source Intelligence & Execution Readiness

required: For a fresh campaign: one direct single-file ZIP URL on Google Drive or GitHub; no pre-created campaign identity or source digest is required
For an existing campaign: exact controller-bound campaign generation/source fence
Current SECURITY_TRACEABILITY_GRAPH checkpoint or initialization authority
Current CARRIED_FORWARD_OBLIGATION_LEDGER checkpoint or initialization authority
GitHub connector access to Audit-Controller and Contract-Automation
conditional: Existing source/build evidence eligible for exact reuse

steps.action: Initialize or bind the exact Lite campaign and source
steps.instruction: For a fresh campaign, provide only the direct single-file ZIP URL to Audit Source Initialization. The workflow MUST derive filename/hash/size/slug, allocate the next rN campaign and g1 generation, create the campaign/source folders, retain the ZIP, safely unpack it into the same source folder, bind Git blob/admission commit/source fence, create initial campaign state and active pointer, publish the active registry entry, and arm the Lite monitor. Repeated source submissions create a new rN; exact workflow retries are idempotent. Existing campaigns are bound from durable controller state.

steps.action: Verify initialized source fence and extraction
steps.instruction: Verify the Audit Source Initialization outputs: exact URL-derived archive identity, SHA-256, byte length, Git blob, source-admission commit, canonical source path and unpacked-tree digest. Do not manually duplicate the mechanical source/test/script inventory; the retained Phase-0 intelligence automation performs that inventory.
Prove connector reads to both repos; inspect current Contract-Automation qualification and, when stale/absent, trigger and observe the existing qualification/bridge path to terminal evidence.

steps.action: Initiate and supervise required existing bootstrap automation
steps.instruction: Using only existing execution/bridge capabilities, trigger required exact-build/static/SBOM/structural execution, observe every required run to terminal state, collect exact identities/artifacts, and repair/retry mechanically recoverable failures.
Establish exact compiler/build/toolchain identity and accepted compiler artifacts from the frozen source.

steps.action: Generate and seal canonical Source Intelligence core
steps.instruction: Fill the exact template with neutral structural source/build/security-surface/topology facts only.

steps.action: Attach neutral static reconnaissance and SBOM
steps.instruction: Attach exact Slither/static/SBOM/tool evidence and candidate indexes without promoting analyzer output to findings.

steps.action: Initialize overlays and pin accepted bundle index
steps.instruction: Initialize structural discovery/readiness states only; validate/commit overlay revisions and Bundle Index identities.

steps.action: Front-load neutral specification dependency and standards inputs
steps.instruction: Mechanically index documented roles/intent/interfaces/exclusions, dependency identities/interfaces/upgrade facts and claimed standards only; defer semantic interpretation.
Ensure reusable structural indexes are represented in accepted Source Intelligence/evidence wherever current source/tooling supports them; do not create duplicate parallel intelligence packages.

steps.action: Complete the frozen Bootstrap Audit Surface Manifest
steps.instruction: Reconcile source/build/dependency/deployable/static/Source-Intelligence identities and neutral documented-input indexes.
Update structural graph roots, Phase-0 due obligations and evidence invalidation state without semantic security conclusions.

steps.action: Freeze the Web Bootstrap Completion Report
steps.instruction: File the immutable Phase-0 evidence report with automation/request/run/job/artifact identities and pre-handoff output digests. Mark it READY_FOR_HANDOFF_CONSTRUCTION. Do not include P0_TO_P1 validation/digests or wake-message hashes; Step 14 binds to this frozen report and must never require rewriting it.

steps.action: Create and validate P0_TO_P1 successor package and Phase-1 wake message
steps.instruction: Using the already-frozen Step-13 report digest, create and validate SUCCESSOR_HANDOFF.json, START_HERE_SUCCESSOR.md, and the standardized WAKE_UP_MESSAGE.md for fresh reviewer-1 before requesting controller completion validation. Never mutate the frozen Step-13 report after the handoff binds its digest.

phaseRequirement: Initialize graph and add SOURCE-*/structural roots; semantic security conclusions prohibited.

sealingCriteria: All mandatory Phase-0 steps completed or have a permitted typed terminal limitation/failure disposition.
Every required existing Contract-Automation/bootstrap run is terminal and its request/run/job/artifact evidence identity is recorded; merely triggering a run is insufficient.
Exact build/compiler/toolchain identity is accepted for the frozen source.

Canonical Source Intelligence core is filled from the supplied exact template, has no __FILL_REQUIRED__ sentinel, is exact-source/build-bound, and contains the supported neutral structural inventories without semantic security conclusions.
Neutral Slither/static/SBOM evidence is attached or explicitly typed-limited; analyzer output has not been promoted to findings.
Runtime/deployment and assurance-readiness overlays are initialized with structural discovery/readiness facts only and pinned in an accepted Bundle Index.
Bootstrap Audit Surface Manifest is complete and exact-source/build-bound, including neutral documented inputs, dependency/standards identities and reusable structural index references.
Security Traceability Graph and obligation ledger are updated for Phase 0; no due OPEN/IN_PROGRESS Phase-0 obligation remains.
Every material observed change is classified under EVIDENCE_INVALIDATION_MATRIX.

PHASE0_WEB_BOOTSTRAP_COMPLETION_REPORT is complete, frozen exactly once before handoff construction, digest-bound, and states READY_FOR_HANDOFF_CONSTRUCTION; it contains no Step-14 handoff-validation result or wake-message digest that would create a rewrite/rebind cycle.

P0_TO_P1 SUCCESSOR_HANDOFF.json, START_HERE_SUCCESSOR.md, and standardized Phase-1 WAKE_UP_MESSAGE.md are complete, exact-identity-bound and handoff-validation PASS before controller completion validation is requested.

steps: Submit the audit-phase-completion-report-v1 companion bound to the frozen Step-13 Phase-0 report plus the separately validated Step-14 P0_TO_P1 package/wake-message evidence, output digests, step dispositions, sealing-criterion evidence, campaign generation, reviewer lineage and source identity.
Obtain the machine-generated PHASE_COMPLETION_VALIDATION_v1.json receipt with status PASS. This PASS is an output of controller validation and MUST NOT be required as an input to the same validation.
Require the Phase-0 retirement gate to verify the bound Phase completion PASS, required automation-completion PASS, and P0_TO_P1 successor-handoff validation PASS.
Only after the retirement gate reports PASS may controller state enter WAITING_FOR_SUCCESSOR_AGENT and the web-bootstrap-agent retire.
